topic: Budget-constrained RSI for VLA-harness continual learning

hypotheses.H1: Evolved allocation improves all-seen-task budget-AUC relative to a strong fixed allocator, accounting for every improvement and selection cost, without excessive old-task loss.
hypotheses.H2: Allocator-only transfer improves later learning on unseen task sequences from identical executor and initial evidence, with the allocator frozen during the confirmatory transfer comparison.
hypotheses.H3: Risk-directed revalidation improves retention per unit cost beyond uniform revalidation, controlling candidate access and total cost.

splits.D_learn: agent-visible adaptation and revalidation, fully budgeted
splits.D_select: development selection only; not final evaluation
splits.D_curve: sealed offline evaluation of archived snapshots after protocol freeze
splits.D_final: independent task/scene/sequence evaluation, inaccessible to evolving agent

per_run_cap_candidates.control_steps: 20 times common native horizon; horizon pending

pilot_candidate_scale.budget_freeze_rule: Calibrate once before viewing any comparative method results, freeze exact caps in a separate execution protocol with all null manifests resolved; no borrowing from prior closed protocols.
pilot_candidate_scale.claim_limit: Exploratory mechanism feasibility; does not establish superiority or no forgetting.

analysis.independent_unit: complete learning trajectory with randomized order/seed
analysis.episode_pairing: same initial states within trajectory condition pair
analysis.primary_inference: trajectory-level paired randomization and uncertainty intervals
analysis.small_cluster_warning: Six trajectories are a fragile lower bound; do not treat hundreds of within-trajectory episodes as independent learning runs.

pilot_stop_rules: Hard budget or isolation violation stops the run immediately.
Repeated same-layer deployment failure without new evidence stops repeated generation; inspect that layer.
All methods lack actions or base competence: pause algorithm comparison and run bounded common-backend diagnostics.
No E-F mechanism difference at two-week pilot: diagnose equal candidate access and overhead before scaling; do not add unlimited modules.
Task or horizon changes require a new protocol version before comparative data collection.

plateau_definition_candidate.interpretation: No material improvement observed within this model/distribution/budget; not proof of convergence.

native_reproduction_labels.RoboRSI: Native code/tool agent, not automatically a VLA system; common-VLA version is an explicit adaptation.
native_reproduction_labels.RPent: Native RoboTwin-LingBot path with local-Qwen substitution; source fidelity and model substitution reported separately.
native_reproduction_labels.AdaHVLA: Published Go2 example requires explicit manipulation adaptation.
native_reproduction_labels.EmbodiedRSI: Mechanism reimplementation unless complete official runnable source is qualified.
